titleEn: Minimum Domino Rotations For Equal Row
title: 行相等的最少多米诺旋转
summary: 每张多米诺上下各有数字，可翻转任意张，求让所有上排或所有下排数字相同的最少翻转数；无解返回负一。
insight: 若存在可统一数字，它必是第一张牌的上值或下值；分别检查这两个候选并统计统一上排、统一下排所需翻转数。
pitfalls: 某位置上下都不是候选时该候选失败
同时计算上排和下排旋转数并取较小
两个首值相同无需重复检查但重复也不影响结果

solutions.title: 首牌双候选检查
solutions.idea: 只验证第一张牌暴露的两个可能统一值。
steps: 若 tops[i] 和 bottoms[i] 都不等于 target 返回极大值；tops 不等则 topRotations++，bottoms 不等则 bottomRotations++
对 tops[0]、bottoms[0] 取最小旋转数，极大值则返回 -1

code.java: class Solution { public int minDominoRotations(int[] tops,int[] bottoms){int answer=Math.min(check(tops[0],tops,bottoms),check(bottoms[0],tops,bottoms));return answer==Integer.MAX_VALUE?-1:answer;}private int check(int target,int[] tops,int[] bottoms){int top=0,bottom=0;for(int i=0;i<tops.length;i++){if(tops[i]!=target&&bottoms[i]!=target)return Integer.MAX_VALUE;if(tops[i]!=target)top++;if(bottoms[i]!=target)bottom++;}return Math.min(top,bottom);} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun minDominoRotations(tops:IntArray,bottoms:IntArray):Int{fun check(target:Int):Int{var top=0;var bottom=0;for(i in tops.indices){if(tops[i]!=target&&bottoms[i]!=target)return Int.MAX_VALUE;if(tops[i]!=target)top++;if(bottoms[i]!=target)bottom++};return minOf(top,bottom)};val answer=minOf(check(tops[0]),check(bottoms[0]));return if(answer==Int.MAX_VALUE)-1 else answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { int check(int target,vector<int>& tops,vector<int>& bottoms){int top=0,bottom=0;for(int i=0;i<(int)tops.size();++i){if(tops[i]!=target&&bottoms[i]!=target)return INT_MAX;if(tops[i]!=target)++top;if(bottoms[i]!=target)++bottom;}return min(top,bottom);}public:int minDominoRotations(vector<int>& tops,vector<int>& bottoms){int answer=min(check(tops[0],tops,bottoms),check(bottoms[0],tops,bottoms));return answer==INT_MAX?-1:answer;} };
